title: 第21章 炼器第22章 小灵子的决定
lines: 萧羽来到了炼器院，向守门弟子告知了来意，那位弟子也是面露难色，毕竟现在的炼器院实在太忙了，除了他一个搬搬材料，打打杂的学徒之外，整个炼器院连长老和有资质的炼器师也就三人。
所以家族内的损坏的灵器的维修和新灵器的打造，都是由这三人来打造，所以萧羽在这么短的时间内就要打造27个面具，这不是给他们出难题吗？
可是萧羽现在的身份又不是他一个小小的学徒随便就可以拒绝的。
“羽少爷，这个不是小人我能给您答复得了的，我需要向几位大人通报一声，您在这里请稍等。”萧羽点点头。
不一会就见一位体型微胖身着红袍的老者，大步而来，身后还跟着两位十八九岁的年轻人，不用想也知道，这两位就应该是老者的徒弟了，也是一级炼器师。
“就是你小子你张口就要打造27张面具？而且还是今天必须打造出来？”老者声若洪钟的道。
萧羽点点头。
“你小子是在开玩笑吧？我这不是打铁铺子，我是炼器院！炼器院！你知不知道？”老者似乎是被踩了尾巴的猫一样跳了起来
“就算是我答应帮你打，可是时间也来不及，你知道就算打造最低品级的灵器，在不考虑失败率的情况下，我们一天最多只能打造3把！你要是来这里找乐子，赶紧给老子滚！”
萧羽其实对于打造灵器并没有什么概念，但是，小刀给他的《炼器总纲里》不是有一句是“意之所到，灵兵皆成”吗？怎么听起来好像挺难的样子。
萧羽尴尬的摸了摸鼻子：“其实，不需要灵器，黑铁级的面具就可以！”
“滚~”老者一声怒吼。说了这半天是白说了吗？
就是黑铁级的这么短的时间也绝对打不出来，更何况最近和其他三大家族冲突不断，需要维修的灵器太多了，哪里有时间给这个混小子打面具！
这一嗓子，倒是让老者身后的两个年轻人不由得笑了起来。
其中一位女子款款走到萧羽面前：“师弟，你的要求我们实在是没有办法帮到你，不如这样，我们的炼器室借给你，材料也可以任你使用，不需要你支付任何费用，如何？”
萧羽静静看着眼前的女子，起身拱手道：“师姐说话可是当真？”说话间看向红衣的老者。
老者哼了一声，未表示反对。
另一边，另一个身着白衣的男子不断向萧羽使眼色。
萧羽恍若未见，只是目光灼灼的看着女子。女子嫣然一笑：“师弟尽可放心，我说到做到，所有的材料都算到我的头上，这样你可满意？”
“那弟子就谢谢师姐了，时间了紧迫，请师姐直接带我去炼器室吧？”萧羽道。
“那师弟请跟我来。”走进一间炼器室
女子介绍道：“你所需的炼器材料这里都有，应该充足够你用，下面的火是乃是地脉之火！”说完女子转身离去。
“师妹，你何苦刁难那他？”白衣男子看到女子出来道。
“师兄，你有所不知，师尊老人家一直醉心于炼器，不通人情!但是作为弟子，我们须得替师尊分忧，萧羽此人如今是一飞冲天，颇得家族重视，可是他之要求我们又完成不了，所以最好的办法就是让他自己知难而退。”
男子不置可否的摇了摇头。
萧羽此时看着炼器室里的材料，黑铁石，金陨石，天刚银，各种材料不足而一。
萧羽此时心中也是有了想法，赤天歌，弓紫嫣，蛮儿和黑子四人做成金色骷髅面具，其他人制成黑色骷髅面具。
此四人各有特点，以后他们要各自成为领袖，统领人马，萧羽心中已经是有了计较。
萧羽静静的盘膝而坐，脑海中不断回忆《炼器总纲》关于面具篇，凝气成刃，压缩至指尖，用灵魂之力，操控切割金属石材，以保证切割的足够薄，......”
content_en:
Xiao Yu came to the Weapon Refining Academy and informed the gatekeeper of his purpose. The disciple also looked embarrassed. After all, the Weapon Refining Academy was too busy now. Apart from him, an apprentice who moved materials and did odd jobs, there were only three elders and qualified Weapon Refining Masters in the entire Weapon Refining Academy.
Therefore, the repair of damaged spiritual weapons and the creation of new spiritual weapons within the family are all made by these three people. Therefore, Xiao Yu has to create 27 masks in such a short period of time. Doesn't this pose a problem for them?
But Xiao Yu's current status is not something that a young apprentice like him can refuse casually.
"Master Yu, this is not something I can answer for you. I need to inform a few adults. Please wait here." Xiao Yu nodded.
After a while, he saw a fat old man wearing a red robe striding over, followed by two young people in his late teens. It didn't take much to think about it, but he knew that these two should be the old man's apprentices and first-level weapon refiners.
"You kid, you want to make 27 masks just by opening your mouth? And you have to make them today?" the old man said in a loud voice.
Xiao Yu nodded.
"Are you kidding me? I'm not a blacksmith shop, I'm the Weapon Refining Institute! The Weapon Refining Institute! Do you know?" The old man jumped up like a cat whose tail had been stepped on.
"Even if I promised to help you fight, there is not enough time. You know that even if we build the lowest grade spiritual weapon, without considering the failure rate, we can only build 3 weapons a day at most! If you come here to have fun, get out of here!"
Xiao Yu actually had no idea about crafting spiritual weapons, but didn't the "General Guide to Refining Weapons" given to him by Xiao Dao include a sentence that said, "Everything you want can be a spiritual weapon"? Why does it sound like it's difficult?
Xiao Yu touched his nose awkwardly: "Actually, you don't need a spiritual weapon, a black iron-level mask will do!"
"Go away~" the old man roared. Have you been talking for a long time in vain?
Even the Black Iron level cannot be beaten in such a short time, not to mention the recent conflicts with the other three major families, and there are too many spiritual weapons that need to be repaired. Where can I find the time to mask this bastard!
This voice actually made the two young people behind the old man laugh.
One of the women walked up to Xiao Yu and said, "Junior brother, we really can't help you with your request. How about we lend you our refining room and use the materials without you having to pay any fees?"
Xiao Yu looked at the woman in front of him quietly, stood up and cupped his hands and said, "Sister, are you serious about what you said?" He looked at the old man in red as he spoke.
The old man snorted and made no objection.
On the other side, another man in white kept winking at Xiao Yu.
Xiao Yu seemed not to see her, but looked at the woman with burning eyes. The woman smiled sweetly: "Junior brother, don't worry, I will do what I say, and all the materials will be on my head. Are you satisfied with this?"
"Then disciple, I would like to thank my senior sister. Time is running out. Could you please senior sister take me directly to the weapon refining room?" Xiao Yu said.
"Junior brother, please come with me." Walking into a refining room
The woman introduced: "The materials you need for refining are all here. They should be enough for you. The fire below is the fire of the earth's veins!" After speaking, the woman turned and left.
"Junior sister, why are you making things difficult for him?" the man in white said when he saw the woman coming out.
"Senior brother, you don't know something. The master has always been obsessed with refining weapons and is unreasonable! But as disciples, we have to share the master's worries. Xiao Yu is now soaring and is highly valued by the family, but we can't fulfill his requirements, so the best way is to let him retreat."
The man shook his head noncommittally.
Xiao Yu looked at the materials in the refining room at this time, including black iron stone, gold meteorite, Tiangang silver, and all kinds of materials were scarce.
Xiao Yu also had an idea in his mind at this time. Chi Tiange, Gong Ziyan, Man'er and Heizi made golden skull masks, and the others made black skull masks.
These four people each have their own characteristics. From now on, they will each become leaders and lead people. Xiao Yu already has a plan in mind.
Xiao Yu sat cross-legged quietly, constantly recalling the chapter about masks in the "General Guide to Refining Weapons" in his mind. He condensed the air into a blade, compressed it to his fingertips, and used the power of his soul to control the cutting of metal and stone to ensure that the cutting was thin enough..."
title_en: Chapter 21 Weapon Refining Chapter 22 Xiao Lingzi’s Decision
